name: Facilities within 5 km of each district
description: Fetches district boundaries, draws a 5 km zone around each health facility, joins the zones to the districts and colours the districts. A small worked example of the shareable workflow format; it was written by hand, not exported, and has not been run.

steps.note: 5 km around each facility (use a projected CRS, metres)
attach the facility zones to the districts

limitations: Distances are straight-line, not travel time.
The buffer distance is in the layer's own units: reproject to a metric CRS first.
